task: put the gear in the carrier and put a pin in it
image_resize: Fixed square task-area crops, then Pillow LANCZOS resize to 256x256; no padding, stretching or dynamic crop. Overhead 256x256 crop retains native source pixel resolution.
sampling: Regular 20Hz data-clock grid with nearest measured states and aligned source images; next-pose targets remain within each accepted crop
action_semantics: absolute measured left joints 1..6, left gripper rad, right joints 1..6, right gripper rad at the NEXT grid tick (t+0.05s). Kinesthetic next-pose proxy, not sent motor commands. Final observation is omitted if its next state would leave the crop.
state_semantics: measured left joints 1..6, left gripper rad, right joints 1..6, right gripper rad. Both joint and gripper values remain native radians.
camera_assignment: Wrist-to-arm assignments are unverified; preserve USB-port names rather than inventing left/right labels.
timing: Host receive timestamps, not hardware exposure timestamps. Offline nearest-frame alignment may choose a frame slightly later than the grid tick; all actual offsets are retained.
trim_method: Human-ownership gate, subagent whole-clip visual review and dense boundary review; exclude passive falls and irrelevant tail motions
